      "evidence": "Modifies ci/test/02_run_container.py and build/packaging files to fix CI Docker subnet collisions.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves CI reliability issues where concurrent containerized jobs collided on Docker subnets, preventing spurious test failures on the release branch."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to man pages and release notes follow mechanically from code backports.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The documentation updates are incidental generated man pages and release notes accompanying backported fixes rather than standalone documentation work."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches fee estimator source files only incidentally as part of backported commits without changing mempool policy.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR makes no substantive changes to transaction validation, mempool acceptance, or policy rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch block template construction, mining RPCs, or mining interfaces.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mining logic and block template generation are outside the scope of this backport batch."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Backports fixes to src/private_broadcast.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp for private broadcast connection management.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes connection completion and prevents stale retry connections in private broadcast, directly addressing transaction relay and privacy reliability on the release branch."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Fixes bitcoin-cli timeout handling and OpenRPC schema regex in test/functional/rpc_openrpc.py.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves a macOS and BSD failure where bitcoin-cli with -rpcclienttimeout=0 failed with EINVAL in select(), and permits valid empty hex strings in OpenRPC definitions."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test modifications accompany specific P2P and RPC fixes rather than changing test runners or testing infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Functional and fuzz test updates belong to the specific subsystems they test rather than the test framework itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/bitcoin-util.cpp to fix genesis block hash output formatting.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.15,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Corrects byte order when printing genesis block hashes in bitcoin-util, which is a minor display fix in developer tooling."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Timeout capping in src/util/sock.cpp is specifically targeted at fixing bitcoin-cli RPC client behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The Sock::Wait timeout cap is an implementation detail of the bitcoin-cli timeout fix evaluated under RPC."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,

      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not address wallet fund safety, descriptor logic, or user-facing wallet functionality."
    }
  ],
